title: Workflow Outcome Ledger Row
description: Schema for one outcome row in the workflow-outcomes ledger. Each row records the result of one workflow execution. The ledger is append-only: rows are added after each workflow run; existing rows are never edited.

workflow_type.description: Which workflow template was executed. Must match a workflow name from WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES.md or a descriptive slug for ad-hoc workflows.

repo.description: Short repository slug the workflow ran against (e.g. 'perl-lsp-swarm', 'source-repo').

agents_used.description: Total number of agent invocations consumed by the workflow (including sub-agents and adversarial passes).

model_mix.description: Breakdown of model invocations. Keys are model tier names; values are invocation counts. Common keys: haiku, sonnet, opus.

items_processed.description: Total number of discrete work items (PRs, issues, CI failures, etc.) evaluated during the workflow.

merged.description: Number of PRs that were merged as a direct outcome of this workflow.

closed_with_proof.description: Number of items closed with valid close-proof (merge-base check pasted). Per CLOSE_PROOF_POLICY.md.

deferred.description: Number of items deferred to a future wave (labelled or noted, not closed).

false_closes_prevented.description: Number of close actions blocked by the adversarial pass or multi-pass rule (closes that would have been incorrect).

ci_failures_diagnosed.description: Number of distinct CI failure root causes identified and routed to a fix during this workflow.

upstream_gaps_filed.description: Number of follow-up issues filed against upstream tools or repos as a direct outcome of this workflow.

builders_dispatched.description: Number of builder agents dispatched (PRs opened or build tasks queued) as a result of this workflow.

known_gaps.description: List of known gaps, caveats, or estimates in this row's data. Each string should briefly describe the uncertainty. Use empty array if data is fully verified.

cleanup_done.description: True if the post-workflow cleanup checklist (worktrees, branches, stale labels) was completed.

notes.description: Optional free-form notes. Mark estimates with '(estimate)'. Record significant incidents, policy changes, or follow-up actions here.

examples.notes: 4 blockers verified genuine; 3 false-blocker claims refuted by adversarial pass.
